title: Coinbase combines rules, conventional ML and a bounded fraud agent
friendlyTitle: Coinbase uses a small, focused AI agent to help detect fraud
summary: Coinbase describes adding an LLM reviewer after its existing fraud model and rules for selected transactions. In its reported online experiment, the combined flow recorded 30% fewer fraudulent transactions and 22% less fraud value; a post-trained 9B model later improved latency and domain metrics against larger general models.
friendlySummary: Coinbase added an AI reviewer after its normal fraud checks and only sends selected transactions to it. The AI gives a risk score but does not control payments itself.
whyItMatters: The useful pattern is narrow and layered: existing controls screen broadly, the agent receives structured evidence, and application code—not the model—applies the decision. Businesses can borrow that architecture without handing an open-ended agent control of high-stakes actions.
friendlyWhyItMatters: AI can be safer and more useful when it has one clear job and normal software keeps control of the final action.
